questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, the landing gear must be:

options.text: Retracted.
Fully raised.
More worn on the passenger's side than on the driver's side.
Well lit.

questions.explanation: When inspecting a trailer, check that the landing gear is fully raised with no missing parts. The crank handle must be secure and the support frame must not be damaged.

questions.question: When exiting a bus, a driver must:

options.text: Never touch the handrail.
Hold the handrail.
Move quickly.

questions.explanation: When exiting the vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For a bus, always hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the test.

questions.question: When exiting a bus during the basic vehicle control skills test, you must:

options.text: Keep both hands on the handrail.
Not touch the handrail.
Hold the handrail firmly.
Rush down the stairs.

questions.explanation: When exiting the vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For a bus, hold the handrail firmly. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the test.

questions.question: When students board a school bus, the driver should:

options.text: Read a book.
Check all mirrors.
Only look at the students.

questions.explanation: While students board the bus, watch all mirrors to see if any students are running to catch the bus.

questions.question: When doing an offset back/right parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pull straight forward, then back to the right.
Pull straight forward, then back to the left.
Pull forward to the right, then back straight.
Pull forward to the left, then back straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull straight forward, then back to the right.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/right parking maneuver, pull straight forward first, then back up to the right. Park your vehicle completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, a look is when:

options.text: A driver checks the gauges on the instrument panel.
A driver checks their blind spots.
A driver gets out of the vehicle and walks to the back to check its position.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver gets out of the vehicle and walks to the back to check its position.
questions.explanation: A look means opening your door, leaving your seat, and walking to the back of the vehicle to check its position. You may use only one look during straight line backing. You may use up to two looks for any other maneuver.

questions.question: When taking the basic vehicle control skills test:

options.text: Points are deducted for each pull-up.
A driver is allowed three pull-ups per maneuver.
A pull-up only counts if the driver exits the vehicle first.
Only too many pull-ups count as errors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only too many pull-ups count as errors.
questions.explanation: During the basic vehicle control skills test, one pull-up has no penalty. However, too many pull-ups will count as errors.

questions.question: If you miss a student's stop while driving students home from school, you should:

options.text: Back up to the stop.
Follow local procedures.
Not worry about the student.
Stop quickly and let them exit.

questions.explanation: If you miss a student's unload stop, do not back up. Instead, follow the procedures your local school has established.

questions.question: When students are being picked up by a school bus:

options.text: Students should wait at a designated bus stop.
The driver should pick up students who are walking toward a designated bus stop.
Parents may choose where the bus stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: Students should wait at a designated bus stop.
questions.explanation: School bus drivers may only pick up students at official stops set by authorized school officials.

questions.question: If a bus has outside convex mirrors, they are located:

options.text: Below the outside flat mirrors.
Above the outside flat mirrors.
Next to the door.
On top of the bus.

questions.explanation: Outside convex mirrors are located below the outside flat mirrors. They help you see a wide view of traffic, clearance, and students around the bus.

questions.question: When backing into an alley, what should you do first?

options.text: Position your vehicle directly in front of the alley.
Back up directly in front of the alley.
Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.
questions.explanation: When backing into an alley, first drive past it and stop parallel to the outer edge. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley parking space.

questions.question: When approaching a bus stop, what should students do?

options.text: Remain seated.
Stand up and collect their belongings.
Walk to the front of the bus to exit.
Ask the driver questions.

questions.explanation: Students must stay seated while the bus is moving. It is unsafe for them to walk around.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located on a school bus?

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side of the bus.

questions.question: What should a driver do when dropping off students at school?

options.text: Turn off the engine to secure the bus.
Leave the key in the ignition when leaving the driver's seat.
Read a book while students unload.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the engine to secure the bus.
questions.explanation: When unloading students, the driver must turn off the engine. Remove the key from the ignition if you leave the driver's seat. Always watch students as they unload.

questions.question: If a header board is on a truck, what condition should it be in?

options.text: Damaged.
Loose.
Strong enough to hold cargo.
Lit up when the engine starts.

questions.explanation: A header board must be secure, undamaged, and strong enough to contain cargo.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, which belt do you NOT need to identify?

options.text: The power steering belt.
The water pump belt.
The alternator belt.
The water compressor belt.

questions.explanation: You must check the power steering belt, water pump belt, alternator belt, and air compressor belt for looseness, cracks, or fraying. There is no water compressor belt.

questions.question: Where should students stay during most emergencies?

options.text: On the bus
On the side of the road near the bus
In a field away from the bus

questions.explanation: In most emergencies, students are safer and easier to control if kept on the bus. Move them to a safe location only if staying on the bus puts them at risk.

questions.question: What is a passive railroad crossing?

options.text: Has a control device.
Does not have any control devices.
Should be avoided.

questions.correctAnswerText: Does not have any control devices.
questions.explanation: A passive crossing has no traffic control devices. The driver must decide whether it is safe to cross.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located on a school bus?

options.text: On the right side of a bus.
On the steering wheel of a bus.
Above the windshield inside a bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside a bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side. Use it to watch students inside the bus.

questions.question: During the basic control skills test, when do you receive points?

options.text: Pull up once.
Check your positioning.
Cross over exercise boundaries.

questions.explanation: Each time your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line, you receive points. These are errors that reduce your test score.
